buildType: fixed-anchor augmentation from hash-pinned iPhone-verified bundles; not a complete Rollup source build

localSources: Shenzhen DB4403/T 298-2022, effective status current as of 2024-10-10: https://weather.sz.gov.cn/xingxigongkai/qita/jishubiaozhun/content/post_11595663.html
registry.localCoverage: Selected sourced Sichuan and Shenzhen extensions only; not an exhaustive register of every jurisdiction
registry.qweatherEventCode: Resolve only when actual eventType.code is present; current QWeather HTML extractor does not provide it

htmlColorCrosswalk.evidence: Fangshan e1 real-device match under Snow Alias Test baseline

requiredMatchKeys: same QWeather point page and Apple areaId
diagnostics: QWeather API severity or government color
feature.detailsLinkModel: WK3 has a collection detailsUrl at collection slot 1 and a per-summary detailsUrl at summary slot 12.
feature.partialMatchBehavior: Only a strictly matched summary with an existing non-empty per-alert detailsUrl receives a one-event native route. The collection URL and unmatched summaries remain unchanged.
feature.sharedOnlyBehavior: If no matched summary has its own detailsUrl, fail open byte-for-byte; do not create per-alert links.
feature.appleEventIdentity: Native detail payload contains only the matched original Apple UUID; request route validates identity, region, event type, severity and publish time.
feature.allMatchedBehavior: Existing shared collection route remains unchanged when every Apple event matches.

fangshan.realDevice: e1 road-icing matched; source/title evidence supports exact snow alias research
fangshan.automatedReplay: synthetic anonymous two-alert fixture passes; not an iPhone result
fangshan.areaIdMissingRegression: synthetic two-alert replay against fangshan-101011200 passes with both original Apple areaId fields absent

wanshan.localReplay: synthetic unknown-enum/type fail-open case only; not a real-response replay

validation.bundleSyntax: node --check passed for request and response bundles
validation.fullBuildNote: This independent branch uses deterministic fixed-anchor builds. A prior baseline build reported private @nsringo/weatherkit package HTTP 401; this branch did not claim a full Rollup build.

limitations: The WK3 wire representation contains both a collection-level link and a per-summary link. Whether Apple Weather on iOS 27.3 follows a rewritten per-summary link is not proven by source replay and must be checked on iPhone.
No raw Zhangjiagang WK3 binary was supplied; the automated partial-match replay is anonymous and synthetic, using the reported event titles and matching pattern.
No iPhone acceptance of this new module has been performed.
The build is a deterministic fixed-anchor augmentation of the accepted bundle, not a full Rollup source build; prior private @nsringo/weatherkit package access returned HTTP 401.
experimentType: independent per-alert selective details routing experiment

requiredChecks: original Apple QWeather details URL parses to one region identifier and 9-digit region code
QWeather candidate areaId matches original URL region code
QWeather candidate source metadata regionIdentifier exactly matches original URL identifier
strict existing type, verified severity, exact issue time, active lifecycle, unique candidate and Apple ID binding
areaIdFallback.fangshanRegression: synthetic dual-alert replay with omitted Apple areaId; not an iPhone result
